title: The Warren: Refreshed
description: A refresh of vanilla Minecraft with primarily quality of life, performance, and visual upgrades built for the Warren community.
body:
This modpack was created for the Warren community and primarily focuses on refreshing vanilla Minecraft with some additional quality of life, performance, and visual upgrades. These include:
- A bigger, better world with Tectonic world generation
- LODs allowing you to see far-off terrain with Voxy
- RPG-style skills with Jobs+
- More crops with Farmer's Delight
- Enchanting overhaul and additions from Enchancement
- Vertical slabs
- Performance improvements, including the Sodium suite
- and several visual improvements, including select shader support with Iris
